entries.definition: A computed metric describing player behaviour relative to the engine reference under matched complexity.
A measurement falling outside the expected distribution for the player's rating band and game phase.
The relationship between move precision and the computational complexity of the position.
A short run of consecutively near-optimal moves in high-complexity positions.
A contiguous segment of plies where the aggregated suspicion score crosses an elevated regime.
The bootstrap-derived confidence interval around an aggregated suspicion score.
A classified phase of the game (opening, middlegame, endgame) used to scope a signal.
The locked Stockfish + UCI option set used to generate the comparison evaluation.
A resampling-based statistic carrying its own confidence interval.
The locked-engine-options promise that re-running an audit produces a bit-identical artefact on the same architecture.
The embedded record listing every input hash, engine version, and tooling version needed to re-render the artefact.
